Row.Text: I am Xi Jinping, President of the People's Republic of China. China values stability, development, and mutual respect between nations. Let us begin our relationship with cooperation and a clear understanding of our shared interests.
Welcome. China believes that nations can prosper through cooperation, development, and mutual respect. I hope our two civilizations can find opportunities to advance together.
Even at this distance from our capitals, there is value in dialogue. Great partnerships often begin with a single meeting. Let us see what our nations can achieve together.
We sought stability and peaceful development, but circumstances have forced another path. China will act decisively to protect its interests and secure its future.
You have chosen confrontation with China. Do not mistake our preference for stability as weakness. We will defend our nation and respond with determination.
China has endured centuries of hardship and transformation. Defeat may end my rule, but it will not erase the strength, history, or determination of the Chinese people.
Agreed. Cooperation creates opportunities for both of our nations. May this agreement bring greater stability, prosperity, and mutual benefit.
These terms do not offer sufficient benefit to China. Return with a more balanced proposal, and we may continue our discussions.
Welcome. Let us discuss how our nations may move forward together.
Then our discussion is concluded. I look forward to seeing what the future brings.
Your civilization understands the importance of development, prosperity, and long-term strength. China respects those who invest in their people and prepare confidently for the future.
Your civilization has allowed opportunity to pass it by. A nation that neglects development and prosperity risks falling behind those willing to invest in their future.
Our relationship continues to develop in a positive direction. China values reliable partners, and I hope our cooperation will bring lasting prosperity to both our nations.
Relations between our nations are becoming more difficult. China prefers cooperation, but mutual respect and consideration of our interests are necessary if trust is to continue.
